newsitem.title: USA: Dell sees big demand from owners of old PCs.
newsitem.headline: Dell sees big demand from owners of old PCs.

text.p: Dell Computer Corp Chief Financial Officer Tom Meredith said Tuesday surging demand from owners of older personal computers will boost revenues in the next two years.

About 135 million personal computers based on micro processors older than the top of the line Pentium will be replaced, and Dell, which is one of the favored vendors among second time personal computer buyers, will benefit, Meredith said.

"There will be a bow wave of replacements" as customers look for machines that can handle Internet access and a new generation of software, he said at a Montgomergy Securities investment conference here.
On Monday Dell said it expects a "strong" third quarter based on robust worldwide personal computer sales.
